data.verdict: POLARIZATION REMOVES THE BLOW-UP BUT DOES NOT LAND ON 8π (scope-(a), α_EM T3). The polarized (holomorphic, factorized) determinant measure on Jac(Bring)=E_5τ₀³×E_τ₀ = 8.226285222 — O(1), vs the unpolarized real det′Δ's ~1.47e12. So polarization IS essential (confirms #3941) and the polarized object is the factorized holomorphic measure that the genus-4 work retracted for the WRONG (unpolarized) reason. BUT 8.22629 is NOT a clean α_EM coefficient: nearest simple candidate is b₁=8 (measure/8=1.02829, 2.8% off); it is NOT 8π (measure/8π=0.32731), 4π, 2π, or π². Polarization fixes the SCALE; a residual normalization (the compact-`*` projection / #3941's ½·a₀) is unaccounted. No 8π manufactured. No fit; no c_k wired; no tier change.
